frames.text: clamp the timing pointers, which will be found in the tool kit under

frames.name: p104-text-0152
frames.text: the special cylinder base flange nuts No. 8234, so that the pointers

frames.name: p104-text-0153
frames.text: extend over the edge of the timing disk.

frames.name: p104-text-0154
frames.text: 5. With the end of the pencil resting on the top of the piston make

frames.name: p104-text-0155
frames.text: a mark with a knife blade about one-half inch above the edge of the

frames.name: p104-text-0157
frames.text: 6. Turn the engine over in a forward direction until the pencil

frames.name: p104-text-0158
frames.text: has moved down so that the mark is even with the top edge of the

frames.name: p104-text-0159
frames.text: hole, and with a piece of chalk or a pencil mark the disk in line with

frames.name: p104-text-0161
frames.text: 7. Turn the engine backward until the pencil has moved up and

frames.name: p104-text-0162
frames.text: down to the point where the mark is again even with the top of the

frames.name: p104-text-0163
frames.text: spark-plug hole, and mark the disk in line with the pointer.

frames.name: p104-text-0164
frames.text: 8. With a pair of dividers find the point midway between the two

frames.name: p104-text-0165
frames.text: marks on the disk. This point will indicate the exact dead center

frames.name: p104-text-0166
frames.text: of No. 1 and No. 6 cranks and should be marked with chalk or pencil.

frames.name: p104-text-0167
frames.text: 9. Turn the engine over until this dead-center mark is in line

frames.name: p104-text-0168
frames.text: with the pointer. Allow the crank shaft to remain in this position;

frames.name: p104-text-0170
frames.text: 10. Reset the pointers so that they come in line with the dead-

frames.name: p104-text-0171
frames.text: center marks stamped on the disk.

frames.name: p104-text-0172
frames.text: 11. Turn the engine over in the direction of rotation through 10°

frames.name: p104-text-0173
frames.text: as indicated by the scale on the disk.

frames.name: p104-text-0175
frames.text: The crank shaft is now set on the neutral point of No. 6 left cylinder

frames.name: p104-text-0176
frames.text: and the firing point-spark retarded of No. 1 left cylinder. Reference

frames.name: p104-text-0177
frames.text: to the timing instructions will explain what is meant by “neutral

frames.name: p104-text-0178
frames.text: point.” It is the point 10° past the top dead center which marks

frames.name: p104-text-0179
frames.text: the beginning and end of the cycle of operations. The exhaust valve

frames.name: p104-text-0180
frames.text: closes and the inlet valve opens at this point.

frames.name: p105-text-0182
frames.text: Mount the generator drive-shaft assembly No. 8210, being careful

frames.name: p105-text-0183
frames.text: that the gasket No. 8347 is in place and a sufficient number of shims

frames.name: p105-text-0184
frames.text: No. 8511 (0.002 inch thick) to insure proper mesh of the generator

frames.name: p105-text-0185
frames.text: drive-shaft lower gear with the crank-shaft gear. These gears

frames.name: p105-text-0186
frames.text: should have a minimum back lash of 0.005 inch and a maximum of

frames.name: p105-text-0188
frames.text: Mount the two cam-shaft drive shafts No. 8208, meshing the

frames.name: p105-text-0189
frames.text: gears in such a manner that the mark on the splined coupling is “fore

frames.name: p105-text-0190
frames.text: and aft” or parallel with the center line of the engine.

frames.name: p105-text-0191
frames.text: Now mount the cam-shaft housing assemblies.

frames.name: p105-text-0192
frames.text: If it was not found necessary to replace either the cam shaft or

frames.name: p105-text-0193
frames.text: gear, be sure that the marked teeth on both gear and pinion are in

frames.name: p105-text-0194
frames.text: line. This should bring the mark on the splined end of the drive

frames.name: p105-text-0196
frames.text: The assemblies may now be set in place with the splined coupling

frames.name: p105-text-0198
frames.text: Note.—All marks for both right and left cylinders are located
frames.pdf_text: NOTE.—All marks for both right and left cylinders are located

frames.name: p105-text-0199
frames.text: with No. 1–6 cranks 10° past left dead center.

frames.name: p105-text-0200
frames.text: Complete the installation of these assemblies by replacing the

frames.name: p105-text-0201
frames.text: washers No. 112 and the nuts No. 102 and properly cotter pinning

frames.name: p105-text-0203
frames.text: Slip the felt washers No. 8068 into place and tighten up the stuffing

frames.name: p105-text-0206
frames.text: Test the gap between all tappets and the valves which they operate.

frames.name: p105-text-0207
frames.text: The tappet gap for each cylinder should be checked when that cylinder

frames.name: p105-text-0208
frames.text: is on the firing point. The firing point of No. 1 cylinder is the

frames.name: p105-text-0209
frames.text: neutral point of No. 6 on the same side. The firing point of No. 2 is

frames.name: p105-text-0210
frames.text: the neutral point of No. 5. The firing point of No. 3 is the neutral

frames.name: p105-text-0211
frames.text: point of No. 4. The firing point of No. 4 is the neutral point of

frames.name: p105-text-0212
frames.text: No. 3. The firing point of No. 5 is the neutral point of No. 2. The

frames.name: p105-text-0213
frames.text: firing point of No. 6 is the neutral point of No. 1. It will be noticed

frames.name: p105-text-0214
frames.text: that the sum of the numbers of these pair of cylinders is always

frames.name: p105-text-0215
frames.text: seven. For example: to find the firing point of No. 4 cylinder, turn

frames.name: p105-text-0216
frames.text: the engine over, meanwhile watching the No. 3 exhaust valve.

frames.name: p105-text-0217
frames.text: When this valve has just closed and before No. 3 inlet valve has

frames.name: p105-text-0218
frames.text: opened, the neutral point of No. 3 cylinder will have been reached.

frames.name: p105-text-0219
frames.text: This will be the firing point of No. 4. With the engine cold the

frames.name: p105-text-0220
frames.text: clearance between the inlet valve tappets and the valve stems should

frames.name: p105-text-0221
frames.text: be 0.014 to 0.016. The clearance between the exhaust valve tappets

frames.name: p105-text-0222
frames.text: and valve stems should be 0.019 to 0.021. This clearance should be

frames.name: p105-text-0223
frames.text: adjusted by adding or taking out shims under the tappet head.

frames.name: p105-text-0224
frames.text: These shims are made in varying thicknesses; the thick shim No. 8089

frames.name: p105-text-0225
frames.text: being 0.015 inch thick, the medium shim No. 8086 being 0.008 inch,

frames.name: p105-text-0226
frames.text: and the thin shim No. 8087 being 0.003 inch. The combination of

frames.name: p106-text-0229
frames.text: these shims will permit of a very accurate adjustment of the gap.

frames.name: p106-text-0230
frames.text: Be sure that the shims are properly placed and that the nuts on the

frames.name: p106-text-0231
frames.text: tappets are tightly drawn up and cottered.

frames.name: p106-text-0232
frames.text: If it was found necessary to replace either the cam shaft or the cam-

frames.name: p106-text-0233
frames.text: shaft gear, the gear should have been left unmounted as instructed.

frames.name: p106-text-0234
frames.text: In this case proceed as follows:

frames.name: p106-text-0235
frames.text: 1. With No. 1–6 crank set 10° past the left dead center, the

frames.name: p106-text-0236
frames.text: marked splines on the cam-shaft drive shaft set “fore and aft,” the

frames.name: p106-text-0237
frames.text: marked splines on the upper cam-shaft drive shaft in line with them,

frames.name: p106-text-0238
frames.text: the marked tooth on the upper cam-shaft drive shaft gear should be

frames.name: p106-text-0239
frames.text: toward the observer and on the center line of the cylinders.

frames.name: p106-text-0240
frames.text: 2. Without moving any of this assembly rotate the left cam shaft

frames.name: p106-text-0241
frames.text: in a clockwise direction until the No. 6 exhaust valve is just closed

frames.name: p106-text-0242
frames.text: and the inlet valve is just about to open.

frames.name: p106-text-0243
frames.text: 3. Now mesh the cam-shaft gear in such a manner that the teeth

frames.name: p106-text-0244
frames.text: and the flange bolt holes will line up perfectly.

frames.name: p106-text-0245
frames.text: The cam-shaft gear has 48 teeth and is bolted to the flange by

frames.name: p106-text-0246
frames.text: means of seven bolts. This will permit an adjustment of one-seventh

frames.name: p106-text-0252
frames.text: 4. Tighten up two of the cam-shaft gear bolts and check the tapped

frames.name: p106-text-0254
frames.text: TO ADVANCE OR RETARD VALVE SETTING

frames.name: p106-text-0255
frames.text: 5. Now check the opening and closing of the exhaust and inlet

frames.name: p106-text-0256
frames.text: valves as shown on the timing diagram. If it is found that the valves

frames.name: p106-text-0257
frames.text: are late in opening and closing, the number of degrees should be noted

frames.name: p106-text-0258
frames.text: and the cam-shaft gear moved one or more holes in the direction of

frames.name: p106-text-0259
frames.text: rotation without moving the cam-shaft drive shaft or the cam shaft.

frames.name: p106-text-0260
frames.text: Remember that for each hole moved forward the cam shaft is ad-

frames.name: p106-text-0265
frames.text: ° of crank-shaft rotation. If the valves are found to

frames.name: p106-text-0266
frames.text: open early, set the cam-shaft gear backward one or more holes.

frames.name: p106-text-0267
frames.text: Always check valve timing by turning engine in forward direction

frames.name: p106-text-0268
frames.text: of rotation so as to take up all backlash in gears and lost motion

frames.name: p106-text-0270
frames.text: After the gear has been properly located, set the left distributor

frames.name: p106-text-0271
frames.text: driving flange over the bolts in such a position that the marked notch

frames.name: p106-text-0272
frames.text: is in line with the marked tooth on the drive pinion.

frames.name: p106-text-0273
frames.text: Now tighten up and cotter pin the bolts and mark the gear in line

frames.name: p106-text-0274
frames.text: with marked tooth on the drive pinion.

frames.name: p106-text-0275
frames.text: To set the right cam shaft, turn the engine over in the direction of

frames.name: p106-text-0276
frames.text: rotation through 45° or until the No. 1 crank is 10° past the right

frames.name: p106-text-0277
frames.text: dead center. With the crank shaft in this position turn the cam

frames.name: p106-text-0278
frames.text: shaft over in a clockwise direction until the No. 1 exhaust valve is just

frames.name: p106-text-0279
frames.text: closed and the inlet valve is just about to open. Locate the gear in

frames.name: p106-text-0280
frames.text: the same manner as in setting the left cam shaft.

frames.name: p107-text-0282
frames.text: Before mounting the right distributor driving flange, turn the crank

frames.name: p107-text-0283
frames.text: shaft back through 45° or to its original position and set the dis-

frames.name: p107-text-0284
frames.text: tributor drive flange so that the marked notch comes in line with the

frames.name: p107-text-0285
frames.text: marked tooth on the drive pinion, or, in other words, in line with the

frames.name: p107-text-0286
frames.text: center line of the right cylinders.

frames.name: p107-text-0287
frames.text: Now tighten up the cam-shaft gear bolts and cotter pin as before.

frames.name: p107-text-0289
frames.text: Set the two distributor assemblies in place, being careful to get

frames.name: p107-text-0290
frames.text: them on the proper housings right and left.

frames.name: p107-text-0291
frames.text: These distributors are marked R and L on the outside surface of the

frames.name: p107-text-0292
frames.text: spark-control arms. They should be fastened temporarily by means

frames.name: p107-text-0293
frames.text: of two bolts No. 116 each in such a position that the notch on the

frames.name: p107-text-0294
frames.text: distributor base flange coincides with the notch on the cam-shaft

frames.name: p107-text-0296
frames.text: If it has been found necessary to replace either the cam-shaft

frames.name: p107-text-0297
frames.text: housing or the distributor head, and the new parts do not carry these

frames.name: p107-text-0298
frames.text: identifying notches, the distributor should be so set that with the

frames.name: p107-text-0299
frames.text: spark retarded the center line of the cylinders will be midway between

frames.name: p107-text-0301
frames.text: 1. Set the engine on the firing point, spark retarded, No. 1 L

frames.name: p107-text-0302
frames.text: cylinder; in other words, the neutral point of No. 6 L. Reference to

frames.name: p107-text-0303
frames.text: the timing diagram shows that this is 10° past the top dead center.

frames.name: p107-text-0305
frames.text: It is assumed that the contact separation or gap was properly

frames.name: p107-text-0306
frames.text: adjusted (0.010 to 0.013 inch) at the time the distributor heads were

frames.name: p107-text-0307
frames.text: overhauled. The synchronization of the two main breakers on each

frames.name: p107-text-0308
frames.text: distributor may be checked by inserting a card between the contact

frames.name: p107-text-0309
frames.text: points of one breaker and noting the timing of the other. Then

frames.name: p107-text-0310
frames.text: repeating the procedure on the other breaker. If the two main

frames.name: p107-text-0311
frames.text: breakers on a distributor do not open within 1½° of each other, they

frames.name: p107-text-0312
frames.text: may be synchronized in the following manner: Remove the cotter pin

frames.name: p107-text-0313
frames.text: and loosen nut on the bracket, which will allow the complete breaker-

frames.name: p107-text-0314
frames.text: arm bracket assembly to be shifted around the stud as a center.

frames.name: p107-text-0315
frames.text: This will vary the setting of the contact separation or gap, which

frames.name: p107-text-0316
frames.text: should be brought back to the proper limits and the breaker arms

frames.name: p107-text-0317
frames.text: tried again for time of opening. By shifting the breaker-arm bracket

frames.name: p107-text-0318
frames.text: assembly and each time bringing the opening of the contact points

frames.name: p107-text-0319
frames.text: back to the proper limits, a point can be reached where the two

frames.name: p107-text-0320
frames.text: parallel breaker arms will open at exactly the same time, which is the

frames.name: p107-text-0321
frames.text: proper setting for these arms. The auxiliary breaker arm must open

frames.name: p107-text-0322
frames.text: before the parallel breaker arms when the cam is being rotated in a

frames.name: p107-text-0323
frames.text: clockwise direction, as previously explained. If this breaker arm is

frames.name: p107-text-0324
frames.text: not adjusted so that it will open in the above manner, it will not

frames.name: p108-text-0326
frames.text: prevent the back firing of the engine when being rocked on com-

frames.name: p108-text-0327
frames.text: pression preparatory to starting. After the distributor breaker-arm

frames.name: p108-text-0328
frames.text: bracket assembly has been shifted to such a position so as to give the

frames.name: p108-text-0329
frames.text: proper opening of the parallel breaker arms, nut Q should be screwed

frames.name: p108-text-0330
frames.text: down tight and locked in place by cotter pin P. The countact screws

frames.name: p108-text-0331
frames.text: should be adjusted to line up and meet squarely with the contact

frames.name: p108-text-0332
frames.text: points in the breaker arms when the contact points are closed. This

frames.name: p108-text-0333
frames.text: can be accomplished by slightly bending and twisting the brackets

frames.name: p108-text-0335
frames.text: 2. Swing the timing lever on the distributor to the full retarded

frames.name: p108-text-0336
frames.text: position or as far in a clockwise direction as is possible.

frames.name: p108-text-0337
frames.text: 3. Loosen the bolts No. 116 sufficiently that the distributor base

frames.name: p108-text-0338
frames.text: flange can be rotated on the slotted holes.

frames.name: p108-text-0339
frames.text: 4. Connect battery and electric light across the distributor termi-

frames.name: p108-text-0340
frames.text: nals as shown on Plate 66, and rotate the distributor base flange in

frames.name: p108-text-0341
frames.text: a counterclockwise direction until the light just goes out.

frames.name: p108-text-0342
frames.text: Tighten the bolts with the distributor in this position and com-

frames.name: p108-text-0343
frames.text: plete the installation of the bolts No. 116.

frames.name: p108-text-0344
frames.text: 5. Without changing the position of the crank shaft install and

frames.name: p108-text-0345
frames.text: set the right-hand distributor in a similar manner.

frames.name: p109-text-0349
frames.text: 6. The accuracy of the timing should now be checked up by

frames.name: p109-text-0350
frames.text: rotating the crank shaft backward 15° or 20°; then forward very

frames.name: p109-text-0351
frames.text: slowly, meanwhile watching the electric lights. They should both

frames.name: p109-text-0352
frames.text: go out at the same time within a limit of 1½° on the timing disk.

frames.name: p109-text-0353
frames.text: If the pocket flashlight is used instead of the two electric lights and

frames.name: p109-text-0354
frames.text: battery, each distributor head will have to be checked separately

frames.name: p109-text-0355
frames.text: and the time of the break noted according to the timing disk.

frames.name: p109-text-0356
frames.text: 7. Install the cross reach No. 8333 and adjust it so that both dis-

frames.name: p109-text-0357
frames.text: tributor heads will be fully retarded. Check the synchronization of

frames.name: p109-text-0358
frames.text: the two distributor heads with spark lever in advanced position also.

frames.name: p109-text-0359
frames.text: 8. Install the high-tension cable tube and cable assembly, fasten-

frames.name: p109-text-0360
frames.text: ing it by means of the screws No. 201 to the intake headers.

frames.name: p109-text-0361
frames.text: 9. Wire the heads of all these screws so that they will not loosen up.

frames.name: p109-text-0362
frames.text: Caution.—Care should be exercised in placing the distributor head

frames.name: p109-text-0363
frames.text: assembly on the distributor to keep from breaking the rotor brush.

frames.name: p109-text-0364
frames.text: It can best be done by putting the distributor-head assembly over

frames.name: p109-text-0365
frames.text: the two studs upon which it is mounted and slightly rocking it back

frames.name: p109-text-0366
frames.text: and forth with the rotor in the right-angle position to the center

frames.name: p109-text-0367
frames.text: line of the two studs. This will gradually work the brush back into

frames.name: p109-text-0368
frames.text: the rotor and allow the distributor head to slip down into place.

frames.name: p109-text-0369
frames.text: Remove wooden plugs from the spark-plug holes and install spark

frames.name: p109-text-0370
frames.text: plugs. Connect the high-tension wires to them and to the distribu-

frames.name: p109-text-0371
frames.text: tors, being careful that each plug is connected to the proper terminal.

frames.name: p109-text-0372
frames.text: Remember that plugs on the side of the cylinders toward the propeller

frames.name: p109-text-0373
frames.text: are connected to the left-hand distributor and those on the side of

frames.name: p109-text-0374
frames.text: the cylinders toward the gear end of the engine are connected to the

frames.name: p109-text-0376
frames.text: Install the water-pump assembly, being careful to see that the

frames.name: p109-text-0377
frames.text: gasket No. 8345 is in place. Try the mesh of the water-pump gear

frames.name: p109-text-0378
frames.text: with the water-pump bevel drive gear. This should be 0.005 inch

frames.name: p109-text-0379
frames.text: minimum and 0.010 inch maximum. If these gears mesh too tightly,

frames.name: p109-text-0380
frames.text: shims No. 8510 may be inserted between the bearing retainer No.

frames.name: p109-text-0381
frames.text: 8345 and the gasket in sufficient number to produce the proper

frames.name: p109-text-0384
frames.text: Install the water-inlet manifolds No. 12123, replacing the hose con-

frames.name: p109-text-0385
frames.text: nections and clamps wherever the original ones were found to be

frames.name: p109-text-0387
frames.text: Put on the inlet manifold extensions No. 12096 and No. 12097 with

frames.name: p109-text-0389
frames.text: In tightening up hose clamps be careful that the clamp is bent so as

frames.name: p109-text-0390
frames.text: to fit snugly around the hose and bear against it at all points. Do

frames.name: p109-text-0391
frames.text: not draw up the clamps so tightly that the clamp cuts into the rubber.

frames.name: p110-text-0393
frames.text: It is advisable before installing the engine in the tank to tape these

frames.name: p110-text-0394
frames.text: hose connections with a good rubber friction tape and shellac them,

frames.name: p110-text-0395
frames.text: putting clamps on over the shellacked tape. The shellacked tape will

frames.name: p110-text-0396
frames.text: protect the hose from oil and gasoline.

frames.name: p110-text-0398
frames.text: Install the oil-pump assembly. See that the gasket No. 8348 is in

frames.name: p110-text-0399
frames.text: good condition and is so placed that the gasket does not overlap the

frames.name: p110-text-0400
frames.text: oil passages either in the oil pump housing or the crank case.

frames.name: p110-text-0401
frames.text: Install the nuts No. 101 and tighten them up evenly and cotter-pin

frames.name: p110-text-0404
frames.text: Install the crank-case breather. See that the gasket No. 8172 is in

frames.name: p110-text-0405
frames.text: place and fasten with nuts No. 101.

frames.name: p110-text-0406
frames.text: Install the crank-case oil fillers No. 8156 with gaskets No. 8158 and

frames.name: p110-text-0407
frames.text: fasten in place with nuts No. 101.

frames.name: p110-text-0408
frames.text: Install crank-case sump cover No. 8129. Be sure that the lock No.

frames.name: p110-text-0410
frames.text: The whole engine should now be given a careful final inspection.

frames.name: p110-text-0411
frames.text: Make sure that all bolts have been properly drawn up and locked

frames.name: p110-text-0412
frames.text: either by means of cotter pins or lock wires.

frames.name: p110-text-0414
frames.text: The governor is mounted on the front end of the engine, and oper-

frames.name: p110-text-0415
frames.text: ates on the carburetor throttle. It is designed to hold the speed of

frames.name: p110-text-0416
frames.text: the engine below 1,400 r. p. m. A part sectional view of the governor

frames.name: p110-text-0417
frames.text: is shown on page 111. Its method of operation is as follows:

frames.name: p110-text-0418
frames.text: The shaft (No. 1) rotates with the crank shaft of the engine,

frames.name: p110-text-0419
frames.text: carrying with it the sleeve (No. 2) and the balls (No. 3). As the

frames.name: p110-text-0420
frames.text: speed of the shaft increases the balls (No. 3) tend to fly from the

frames.name: p110-text-0421
frames.text: center, due to the centrifugal force, moving the collar (No. 4) along

frames.name: p110-text-0422
frames.text: the shaft and imparting a motion to the linkage (No. 5) which is

frames.name: p110-text-0423
frames.text: connected to the carburetor throttle. The spring (No. 6) is so

frames.name: p110-text-0424
frames.text: designed as to provide a preliminary resistance against the action of

frames.name: p110-text-0425
frames.text: the governor, permitting the engine to reach its designed speed

frames.name: p110-text-0426
frames.text: before the governor comes into action.

frames.name: p110-text-0428
frames.text: To remove the engine all the electric wires should be disconnected

frames.name: p110-text-0429
frames.text: as well as the feed pipes and manifold connections. Disconnect the

frames.name: p110-text-0430
frames.text: fan drive and generator drive and the connections with the cardan

frames.name: p110-text-0431
frames.text: shaft. The plates holding the engine to its foundation should then

frames.name: p110-text-0432
frames.text: be removed, and the engine can be lifted through the top of the hull

frames.name: p110-text-0433
frames.text: by taking off the two bolts directly over the engine.

frames.name: p113-text-0606
frames.text: Fit of stems in guides; diametrical clearance—

frames.name: p115-text-0732
frames.text: The drive is communicated from the engine to the transmission

frames.name: p115-text-0733
frames.text: units by means of a compound clutch. Inasmuch as the complete

frames.name: p115-text-0734
frames.text: machine weighs approximately 40 tons, the clutch has been designed

frames.name: p115-text-0735
frames.text: to gradually overcome the inertia of the heavy mass, and for this

frames.name: p115-text-0736
frames.text: reason provides first a slipping and then a positive engagement.

frames.name: p115-text-0737
frames.text: The slipping engagement is secured by means of asbestos-faced cone

frames.name: p115-text-0738
frames.text: clutch which first comes into play, due to the frictional contact

frames.name: p115-text-0739
frames.text: between the leather facing and the cone-shaped flywheel. The

frames.name: p115-text-0740
frames.text: positive engagement of the clutch is secured by the splines or teeth

frames.name: p115-text-0741
frames.text: on the clutch sleeve, which in turn mesh with corresponding splines

frames.name: p115-text-0742
frames.text: or teeth on the end of the crank shaft.

frames.name: p115-text-0743
frames.text: The function of the cone clutch part of the compound clutch is to

frames.name: p115-text-0744
frames.text: simply pick up and start rotating the transmission drums. After the

frames.name: p115-text-0745
frames.text: friction part of the clutch has accomplished this the positive drive

frames.name: p115-text-0746
frames.text: part then is engaged. The point should be made that the epicyclic

frames.name: p115-text-0747
frames.text: bands should and must be free to operate the clutch properly.

frames.name: p115-text-0748
frames.text: The driving-clutch unit is bolted to the flywheel member of the

frames.name: p115-text-0749
frames.text: engine, and is a cone frustrum of carbon steel. The driving cone

frames.name: p115-text-0750
frames.text: carrying the asbestos facing is forced into frictional contact with the

frames.name: p115-text-0751
frames.text: driving member by means of coil springs ⅝-inch in diameter, 5.85

frames.name: p115-text-0752
frames.text: inches long and having 32 coils. These springs are mounted on

frames.name: p115-text-0753
frames.text: plungers of carbon steel, 4⅞ inches long, and ⅜-inch in diameter.

frames.name: p115-text-0754
frames.text: Engagement of the clutch is secured by playing back on the clutch

frames.name: p115-text-0755
frames.text: lever, which forces the clutch collar to slide along the clutch shaft,

frames.name: p115-text-0756
frames.text: first engaging the cone and then engaging the splines on the collar

frames.name: p115-text-0757
frames.text: with the splines on the crank shaft.

frames.name: p116-text-0804
frames.text: Additional pressure is placed upon the cone by the movement of

frames.name: p116-text-0805
frames.text: the clutch collar by means of the large clutch spring, which is con-

frames.name: p116-text-0806
frames.text: centric upon the clutch shaft, and is composed of the coil spring,

frames.name: p116-text-0807
frames.text: having a 5⅜-inch diameter of spiral and a 4¼-inch length of coil.

frames.name: p116-text-0808
frames.text: The spring is composed of five free coils, and two seating coils.

frames.name: p116-text-0809
frames.text: Engagement between the clutch sliding collar or sleeve and the

frames.name: p116-text-0810
frames.text: cardan shaft is secured by means of a coupling of nickel steel. The

frames.name: p116-text-0811
frames.text: coupling is a 9-inch flange, in diameter, and a diameter of 5 inches at

frames.name: p116-text-0812
frames.text: the point of engagement with the splined end of the cardan shaft.

frames.name: p116-text-0813
frames.text: The cardan shaft is nickel steel, 11¼ inches long, with 10 splined

frames.name: p116-text-0814
frames.text: teeth, and a diameter of 2 inches. The diameter of the splined

frames.name: p117-text-0907
frames.text: The drive is thus imparted through the cone and through the

frames.name: p117-text-0908
frames.text: splines on the crank shaft to the clutch collar. From the clutch

frames.name: p117-text-0909
frames.text: collar it passes to the clutch coupling and thence by means of the

frames.name: p117-text-0910
frames.text: splines on the coupling to the cardan shaft. The preliminary drive

frames.name: p117-text-0911
frames.text: passes from the cone, through the carbon steel key, 4¼ inches long

frames.name: p117-text-0912
frames.text: and ¾ inches thick and ⅜ inches wide to the clutch coupling, and

frames.name: p117-text-0913
frames.text: thence to the cardan shaft. On the rear end of the cardan shaft is

frames.name: p117-text-0914
frames.text: located the clutch pull drum, this being bolted to the flange on the

frames.name: p117-text-0915
frames.text: cardan shaft. A clutch brake or cardan-shaft brake operates on this

frames.name: p117-text-0916
frames.text: drum, stopping the spinning of the cardan shaft in shifting gears.

frames.name: p117-text-0917
frames.text: It is because the cardan shaft is connected directly with the shaft

frames.name: p117-text-0918
frames.text: of the epicyclic gear that it is very necessary that the cardan-shaft

frames.name: p117-text-0919
frames.text: brake be properly adjusted before the machine is driven. It is quite

frames.name: p117-text-0920
frames.text: evident that if the attempt is made to shift into reverse with this

frames.name: p117-text-0921
frames.text: shaft spinning ahead, the driving teeth are apt to be stripped.

frames.name: p117-text-0922
frames.text: Directions of how to adjust the cardan-shaft brake are found on

frames.name: p117-text-0923
frames.text: page 150. The clutch-stop drum is of malleable iron.

frames.name: p117-text-0924
frames.text: When the clutch is thrown out of engagement the crank shaft

frames.name: p117-text-0925
frames.text: rotates freely on the phosphor bronze clutch front bearing. This

frames.name: p117-text-0926
frames.text: has an outside diameter of 4.684 inches, and an inside diameter of

frames.name: p117-text-0927
frames.text: 4.002 inches. The clutch sleeve through which the main drive is

frames.name: p117-text-0928
frames.text: transmitted is nickel steel, having a length of 2.687 inches, and

frames.name: p117-text-0929
frames.text: inside diameter of 3.531 inches and 24 splines.

frames.name: p118-text-0934
frames.text: When removing clutch, first wire the clutch spring (exterior) to

frames.name: p118-text-0935
frames.text: prevent it from expanding when the pressure is released. Remove

frames.name: p118-text-0937
frames.text: Remove the air-pump belt from the clutch-stop drum, also the

frames.name: p118-text-0938
frames.text: clutch-stop band pin, and the bolts connecting the band to the

frames.name: p118-text-0940
frames.text: Remove the eight bolts holding the coupling box to the bevel-

frames.name: p118-text-0941
frames.text: pinion shaft and the six bolts holding the clutch coupling to the clutch

frames.name: p118-text-0943
frames.text: Pull out the pin for fork ends, holding the fork end of the clutch

frames.name: p118-text-0944
frames.text: auxiliary rod to the clutch-operating lever, enabling the clutch shaft

frames.name: p118-text-0945
frames.text: to rotate. The cardan shaft can then be removed by dropping the

frames.name: p118-text-0946
frames.text: rear end and allowing the ball bearings to roll clear of the shaft.

frames.name: p118-text-0947
frames.text: Then remove the crank-shaft nut and gear-lock washer, and pull

frames.name: p118-text-0948
frames.text: the clutch off the crank shaft.

frames.name: p118-text-0950
frames.text: Remove the old lining and chip off the rivets. New lining is pro-

frames.name: p118-text-0951
frames.text: vided, cut to proper size. If this is not available, a new lining can

frames.name: p118-text-0952
frames.text: be cut to proper size, using page 117 as a pattern. New rivets should

frames.name: p118-text-0953
frames.text: be put in in such a way that they are countersunk below the surface

frames.name: p118-text-0954
frames.text: of the lining so that the metal of the rivet will not bear against the

frames.name: p118-text-0955
frames.text: metal clutch-driving face, or split rivets driven from inside are used.

frames.name: p119-text-0958
frames.text: The epicyclic gear set has two forward speeds and two reverse

frames.name: p119-text-0959
frames.text: speeds. It is mounted transversely across the machine in the rear

frames.name: p119-text-0960
frames.text: end of the engine compartment. It provides the necessary gear

frames.name: p119-text-0961
frames.text: reduction between the engine drive and the track propulsion units,

frames.name: p119-text-0962
frames.text: and also carries the drive outward on both sides from the center line

frames.name: p119-text-0963
frames.text: of the machine to the exterior track mechanism.

frames.name: p119-text-0964
frames.text: The drive enters the epicyclic gear set by means of a bevel pinion

frames.name: p119-text-0965
frames.text: drive over the engine and clutch, and leaves it in the form of a general

frames.name: p119-text-0966
frames.text: drive to the track propulsion gearing. The gears are shifted in rela-

frames.name: p119-text-0967
frames.text: tion to one another by means of a shifter-fork mechanism which takes

frames.name: p119-text-0968
frames.text: care of the forward and reverse movements, and, in addition to this,

frames.name: p119-text-0969
frames.text: the high and low speed ratio are secured by means of brakes, which

frames.name: p119-text-0970
frames.text: act on drums governing the ratio of the planetary trains contained in

frames.name: p119-text-0972
frames.text: The reductions in the box are 5 to 1 on low, and 1.285 to 1 on high.

frames.name: p119-text-0973
frames.text: The reduction at the bevel gear is 14.46. The reduction between the

frames.name: p119-text-0974
frames.text: chain sprocket and the roller pinion is 12 to 23, and between the roller

frames.name: p119-text-0975
frames.text: pinion and the track driving wheel 9 to 37. This gives a total reduc-

frames.name: p119-text-0976
frames.text: tion between the engine and track of 32.545 to 1 on high speed, and

frames.name: p119-text-0978
frames.text: The use of the planetary or epicyclic type of gear box on a machine

frames.name: p119-text-0979
frames.text: of this weight does away with the necessity of employing shifting

frames.name: p119-text-0980
frames.text: gears except in the case of changing from forward to reverse. It is

frames.name: p119-text-0981
frames.text: highly necessary, therefore, that the precautions mentioned on

frames.name: p119-text-0982
frames.text: allowing all moving parts to come to rest before shifting from forward

frames.name: p119-text-0983
frames.text: to reverse, be observed. The drive through the various units can

frames.name: p119-text-0984
frames.text: be traced on page 123 and in the chapters dealing with drive units.

frames.name: p119-text-0985
frames.text: The drive from the engine enters the epicyclic gear set by means of a

frames.name: p119-text-0986
frames.text: bevel pinion, and passes to either bevel wheel, depending on whether it

frames.name: p119-text-0987
frames.text: is desired to run the machine backward or forward. Facing toward

frames.name: p119-text-0988
frames.text: the front of the machine, the left bevel wheel provides a reverse

frames.name: p119-text-0989
frames.text: motion, and the right bevel wheel gives ahead motion. Engagement

frames.name: p120-text-1012
frames.text: between the required bevel wheel and the shift is secured by means

frames.name: p120-text-1013
frames.text: of a dog clutch, which slides on the splines of the bevel and epicyclic

frames.name: p120-text-1014
frames.text: cross shaft. Both bevel wheels are in constant mesh with the

frames.name: p120-text-1015
frames.text: bevel pinion, but only one is the driving engagement, due to the

frames.name: p120-text-1016
frames.text: position of the clutch, the other is simply an idler, and has no part in

frames.name: p120-text-1018
frames.text: From the bevel wheel, in engagement with the dog clutch, the drive

frames.name: p120-text-1019
frames.text: passes to the cross shaft, thence to the sun pinion, mounted at the

frames.name: p120-text-1020
frames.text: opposite extremity of the cross shaft, from the bevel wheels. The

frames.name: p120-text-1021
frames.text: sun pinion meshes with the large planet pinion, and this in turn

frames.name: p120-text-1022
frames.text: meshes with the annular ring gear, secured to the gear casing. This

frames.name: p120-text-1023
frames.text: casing carries with it the low-speed brake, the same bolt passing

frames.name: p120-text-1024
frames.text: through the annular ring, and the two halves of the epicyclic casing.

frames.name: p120-text-1025
frames.text: The casing also carries the drive back to the chain-drive sprocket,

frames.name: p120-text-1026
frames.text: when it is not restrained in doing so by the application of the brake

frames.name: p120-text-1027
frames.text: mounted upon it. The epicycle gear casing also carries a pin, upon

frames.name: p120-text-1028
frames.text: which is mounted the small epicyclic planet pinion, which meshes

frames.name: p120-text-1029
frames.text: with a small epicyclic spur ring, carried on an epicyclic spur disk,

frames.name: p120-text-1030
frames.text: which in turn is splined to the epicyclic cross shaft. Revolving with

frames.name: p120-text-1031
frames.text: the face which carries the spindle for the small epicyclic pinion is the

frames.name: p120-text-1032
frames.text: high-speed brake, which acts as part of the gear-changing mechanism,

frames.name: p120-text-1035
frames.text: The drive through the epicyclic gears is similar on forward and

frames.name: p120-text-1036
frames.text: reverse speeds, except that of the bevel gears. Referring to page —,

frames.name: p120-text-1037
frames.text: the clutch X is shifted by the fork Z so that the clutch engages with

frames.name: p120-text-1038
frames.text: the bevel wheel B for forward speeds, and with the bevel wheel W

frames.name: p120-text-1039
frames.text: for reverse speeds. Other than this, the progress of the drive on

frames.name: p120-text-1040
frames.text: high and low gear is the same.

frames.name: p120-text-1042
frames.text: The epicyclic transmission gears are arranged for high-speed ratio

frames.name: p120-text-1043
frames.text: when the high-speed brake is applied on the band G, and the low-

frames.name: p120-text-1044
frames.text: speed brake on the band N is released. Due to the position of these

frames.name: p120-text-1045
frames.text: two brakes and the clutch X being in mesh with the bevel wheel B,

frames.name: p120-text-1046
frames.text: the drive progresses from the bevel pinion A to the bevel wheel B,

frames.name: p120-text-1047
frames.text: and thence through the clutch X to the cross shaft C. From the

frames.name: p120-text-1048
frames.text: cross shaft C the drive goes to the epicyclic disk D, and thence to

frames.name: p120-text-1049
frames.text: the spur ring V. The spur ring V meshes with the three planetary

frames.name: p120-text-1050
frames.text: pinions E, causing them to rotate about the planet pins P, as an

frames.name: p120-text-1051
frames.text: axis, and also to roll around the circumference of the sun pinion F.

frames.name: p120-text-1052
frames.text: This pinion is locked in position, due to the application of the high-

frames.name: p120-text-1053
frames.text: speed brake G. As the planet pinions E rotate about the circum-

frames.name: p120-text-1054
frames.text: ference of the sun pinion F, they carry with them the pinion pins P,

frames.name: p120-text-1055
frames.text: which in turn carry the housing Q. This housing Q is rotating about

frames.name: p122-text-0004
frames.text: the cross shaft. The housing Q carries the epicyclic spur ring R,

frames.name: p122-text-0005
frames.text: which meshes with the large planet pinions H, of which there are

frames.name: p122-text-0006
frames.text: three. The rotation of the spur ring R causes the planet pinion H

frames.name: p122-text-0007
frames.text: to roll around the sun pinion I, and as it rolls around it carries with

frames.name: p122-text-0008
frames.text: it by means of the large planet pinion T the disk J, which communi-

frames.name: p122-text-0009
frames.text: cates the drive to the shaft M and thence to the track brake K and

frames.name: p122-text-0061
frames.text: Bolts for planet pinion ring, large.

frames.name: p122-text-0103
frames.text: Bolts for planet pinion ring, small.

frames.name: p126-text-0317
frames.text: On low gear the brake is applied to the low-speed brake band, while

frames.name: p126-text-0318
frames.text: the high-speed brake G is released. This condition of the brakes

frames.name: p126-text-0319
frames.text: which control the speeds permits of the following progress of drive for

frames.name: p126-text-0321
frames.text: The bevel pinion A meshes with and drives the bevel-ring gear B,

frames.name: p126-text-0322
frames.text: and by means of the clutch X the cross shaft C. This carries with it,

frames.name: p126-text-0323
frames.text: idly, the parts D, V, E, F, and G, these being all free to revolve, due to

frames.name: p126-text-0324
frames.text: the release of the high-speed brake G. The pin P, however, is

frames.name: p126-text-0325
frames.text: fixed, due to the application of the low-speed brake N. Thus the

frames.name: p126-text-0326
frames.text: drive goes from the cross shaft C to the sun pinion I, to which it is

frames.name: p126-text-0327
frames.text: splined; thence to the planet pinion H, which rotates within the epi-

frames.name: p126-text-0328
frames.text: cyclic spur ring R, which is fixed by reason of the application of the

frames.name: p126-text-0329
frames.text: low-speed brake. As the planet pinion H travels around within the

frames.name: p126-text-0330
frames.text: epicyclic spur ring R it carries with the pin T and the planet disk J,

frames.name: p126-text-0331
frames.text: by means of which the drive is communicated to the shaft M.

frames.name: p126-text-0333
frames.text: As stated, the progress of the drive on high reverse and low reverse

frames.name: p126-text-0334
frames.text: is exactly the same as for high forward and low forward, except for the

frames.name: p126-text-0335
frames.text: meshing of the clutch X with the bevel wheel Y instead of the bevel

frames.name: p127-text-0385
frames.text: To remove the epicyclic gear from the hull the following operations

frames.name: p127-text-0387
frames.text: 1. Remove from the hull the side plates on the right and left end of

frames.name: p127-text-0388
frames.text: the epicyclic gear set and also the outlet louver.

frames.name: p127-text-0389
frames.text: 2. Disconnect and remove the oil pump.

frames.name: p127-text-0390
frames.text: 3. Disconnect and remove the gasoline-feed pipes running above the

frames.name: p127-text-0391
frames.text: epicyclic gear set, and also remove the radiator and fan, together with

frames.name: p127-text-0394
frames.text: 5. Disconnect and remove the driving shaft.

frames.name: p127-text-0395
frames.text: 6. Remove both driving chains so as to release the chain sprocket.

frames.name: p127-text-0396
frames.text: 7. Remove the bolts holding the epicyclic gear set to the rear bulk-

frames.name: p127-text-0397
frames.text: head, which leaves the epicyclic gear free to be removed as a complete

frames.name: p127-text-0398
frames.text: unit from either side of the hull.

frames.name: p127-text-0400
frames.text: To put the epicyclic gear set into position in the hull the space

frames.name: p127-text-0401
frames.text: which it occupies should be cleared of all obstructions and the chain

frames.name: p127-text-0402
frames.text: casing should be in position. After these precautions have been

frames.name: p127-text-0403
frames.text: taken the operations for mounting the epicyclic gears in position is

frames.name: p127-text-0405
frames.text: 1. Remove from the hull the side plates and outlet louver on the

frames.name: p127-text-0406
frames.text: right and left end of the epicyclic position.

frames.name: p127-text-0407
frames.text: 2. By means of a chain hoist or other convenient apparatus lift the

frames.name: p127-text-0408
frames.text: epicyclic gear set into position and place it transversely across the hull.

frames.name: p127-text-0409
frames.text: Place the bolts in position holding the epicyclic gear to the rear

frames.name: p127-text-0411
frames.text: 3. Place the driving chains in position.

frames.name: p127-text-0412
frames.text: 4. Assemble the connecting and driving shaft.

frames.name: p127-text-0414
frames.text: 6. Connect all the gasoline-feed pipes and place the radiator in

frames.name: p127-text-0415
frames.text: position together with fan air duct.

frames.name: p127-text-0416
frames.text: 7. Place the oil pump in position and make the necessary connec-

frames.name: p127-text-0418
frames.text: 8. Replace the side plates on the hull and the outlet louver.

frames.name: p129-text-0424
frames.text: PROGRESS OF DRIVE THROUGH THE VARIOUS PROPELLING UNITS OF THE 35-TON TANK, MARK VIII. THE DRIVE PASSES FROM THE CLUTCH

frames.name: p129-text-0425
frames.text: TO THE BEVEL GEARS, THEN TO THE EPICYCLIC TRANSMISSION, FROM WHICH IT PASSES TO THE TRACK BY MEANS OF THE CHAIN,

frames.name: p129-text-0426
frames.text: ROLLER SPROCKET, AND ROAD TRACK DRIVING WHEEL.

frames.name: p130-text-0431
frames.text: The drive is taken from the epicyclic gear and transmitted to the

frames.name: p130-text-0432
frames.text: track by means of a driving chain. The driving sprocket is mounted

frames.name: p130-text-0433
frames.text: on the epicyclic cross shaft and takes the drive directly from the

frames.name: p130-text-0434
frames.text: epicyclic gear. From this point it passes to the roller pinion which

frames.name: p130-text-0435
frames.text: has the sprocket wheel at its center and the roller-pinion drive on

frames.name: p130-text-0436
frames.text: each side of the center. These roller pinions mesh in turn with the

frames.name: p130-text-0437
frames.text: road track driving wheel, which engages directly with the track; so

frames.name: p130-text-0438
frames.text: that the progress of the drive is from the epicyclic gears through the

frames.name: p130-text-0439
frames.text: driving sprocket; thence by chain to the sprocket on the roller

frames.name: p130-text-0440
frames.text: pinion, and from the roller pinion to the road track driving wheel

frames.name: p130-text-0441
frames.text: which is driven by the rollers on the roller pinion. This drives in

frames.name: p130-text-0444
frames.text: The chain-sprocket pinion is mounted on the epicyclic driving shaft

frames.name: p130-text-0445
frames.text: and is driven by it. It has 12 teeth of three pitch for driving the

frames.name: p130-text-0446
frames.text: roller chain. This pinion can be slipped off the end of the shaft after

frames.name: p130-text-0447
frames.text: the epicyclic assembly is removed from its case. It is a part of this

frames.name: p130-text-0448
frames.text: assembly and is the unit which transmits the drive from the epicyclic

frames.name: p130-text-0503
frames.text: Road track driving wheel diameter, outside

frames.name: p130-text-0506
frames.text: Road track driving wheel diameter, inside

frames.name: p130-text-0509
frames.text: Number of road track driving-wheel teeth

frames.name: p131-text-0529
frames.text: ⅛-inch taper plug for roller pin.

frames.name: p132-text-0558
frames.text: gearset to the chain. The chain sprocket pinion is a drop forging and

frames.name: p132-text-0559
frames.text: engages with the epicyclic shaft by means of 10 splines. It has a total

frames.name: p132-text-0560
frames.text: width on the shaft of 4 inches. Its pitch is 11.592-inch and its teeth

frames.name: p132-text-0563
frames.text: The driving sprocket chain is a chain which connects the chain

frames.name: p132-text-0564
frames.text: sprocket pinion on the epicyclic transmission system with the roller

frames.name: p132-text-0565
frames.text: pinion which in turn drives the track driving wheel. The driving

frames.name: p132-text-0566
frames.text: sprocket chain is designed to operate under a maximum working load

frames.name: p132-text-0567
frames.text: of 53,000 pounds and has a breaking load of 150,000 pounds. It is a

frames.name: p132-text-0568
frames.text: 3-pitch chain, and has a length of 50 pitches. The chain is made up

frames.name: p132-text-0569
frames.text: of outer and inner bars which connect the rollers. The outside and

frames.name: p132-text-0570
frames.text: inside bars are of 40 carbon, hot-rolled steel. The distance between

frames.name: p132-text-0571
frames.text: the outside bars is 2⅞ inches and between the inside bars 1

frames.name: p132-text-0576
frames.text: The outside bars are ½ inch thick and the inside bars are ⅝ inch

frames.name: p132-text-0581
frames.text: inches in diameter, and are of nickel steel.

frames.name: p132-text-0582
frames.text: The pins are held in place by a ⅜ inch by 1¾ inch split pin. The

frames.name: p132-text-0583
frames.text: holes through which the pins pass are reamed to 1.231 inches, giving

frames.name: p132-text-0584
frames.text: a 0.005 clearance between the pin and the hole. Surrounding each

frames.name: p132-text-0585
frames.text: pin is an open-hearth steel bushing which takes the wear.

frames.name: p132-text-0587
frames.text: The chain sprocket and roller pinion is one assembly, being cast

frames.name: p132-text-0588
frames.text: iron and carrying the roller sprocket in the center, and the roller

frames.name: p132-text-0589
frames.text: pinions on each side of the center. The drive is transmitted by the

frames.name: p132-text-0590
frames.text: chain to the chain sprocket, which is an iron casting, also carrying

frames.name: p132-text-0591
frames.text: the roller pinions shaft which is fixed and screwed to the inside and

frames.name: p132-text-0592
frames.text: outside plating of the hull. The chain case surrounds the central

frames.name: p132-text-0593
frames.text: portion of the casing, or that portion that is known as the chain

frames.name: p132-text-0595
frames.text: The length over all of this unit casting which acts as a chain sprocket

frames.name: p132-text-0596
frames.text: and a carrying part for the roller pinion is 19½ inches. The diameter

frames.name: p132-text-0597
frames.text: at the roller-pin bosses is 13.687 inches, and the diameter of the

frames.name: p132-text-0598
frames.text: sprocket is 23.031 inches. The sprocket has 23 teeth, 1.39 inches

frames.name: p132-text-0599
frames.text: wide. The rollers are nickel steel, 2 inches in diameter, and 2.37

frames.name: p132-text-0600
frames.text: inches long. They revolve on pins, pasisng between the bosses,

frames.name: p132-text-0601
frames.text: these pins being nickel steel 5.593 inches long and 1¾ inches in

frames.name: p132-text-0602
frames.text: diameter. The shaft about which the roller pinion revolves is carbon

frames.name: p132-text-0603
frames.text: steel 25¼ inches long and 4.434 inches in diameter.

frames.name: p132-text-0604
frames.text: The casting revolves on the bronze bushing, and is lubricated by

frames.name: p132-text-0605
frames.text: the hole drilled through the center of the shaft, and having leads from

frames.name: p132-text-0606
frames.text: the center out to the bushing. The ends of the hole through the

frames.name: p132-text-0607
frames.text: center of the shaft are sealed by ¾ inch pipe plugs, the one on the

frames.name: p132-text-0608
frames.text: inside being cut off flush after being screwed in, and the one on the

frames.name: p132-text-0609
frames.text: outside being left with its head so that it can be removed for the

frames.name: p133-text-0613
frames.text: The roller pinions mesh with the road track driving wheel. This is

frames.name: p133-text-0614
frames.text: of cast manganese steel, 39.237 inches in diameter, having 35 teeth,

frames.name: p133-text-0615
frames.text: 3.735 pitch and 2 inches in width. The tooth operation of the

frames.name: p133-text-0616
frames.text: steel is a manganese steel casting, these two tooth rings are riveted

frames.name: p133-text-0617
frames.text: to a series of diaphragm plates which are in turn riveted to the road

frames.name: p133-text-0618
frames.text: track driving wheel disks. The disks are riveted to bosses of the

frames.name: p133-text-0619
frames.text: road track driving wheel, and this entire assembly revolves on the

frames.name: p133-text-0620
frames.text: road track driving-wheel shaft bronze bushing. This bushing is

frames.name: p133-text-0621
frames.text: lubricated similar to the bushing of the roller pinion and chain

frames.name: p133-text-0622
frames.text: sprocket by means of a lead drilled through the axis of the driving-

frames.name: p133-text-0623
frames.text: wheel shaft to about the center of its length. From this point there

frames.name: p133-text-0624
frames.text: is a lead to the bushing. The opening to the oil lead is sealed by a

frames.name: p133-text-0625
frames.text: pipe plug which is removed when oil is introduced.

frames.name: p133-text-0657
frames.text: Key for road track driving wheel shaft.

frames.name: p134-text-0661
frames.text: The road track driving-wheel shaft is carbon steel, 27.625 inches

frames.name: p134-text-0662
frames.text: long and 4.434 inches in diameter. The bushing upon which the

frames.name: p134-text-0663
frames.text: road track driving wheel rotates is bronze, 5.118 inches in diameter,

frames.name: p134-text-0664
frames.text: and 8 inches long, and interchangeable with the bushing upon which

frames.name: p134-text-0665
frames.text: the chain sprocket and roller pinion rotates. This bushing is re-

frames.name: p134-text-0666
frames.text: newable after wear by simply driving them off the shafts and replacing

frames.name: p134-text-0669
frames.text: To remove the drive chain, the following operations should be

frames.name: p134-text-0671
frames.text: 1. Break the track over the rear mud pocket by removing one

frames.name: p134-text-0672
frames.text: of the connecting links at this point.

frames.name: p134-text-0673
frames.text: 2. Roll drive chain around until the key link is on the top.

frames.name: p134-text-0675
frames.text: 4. Secure hold on the end of the chain coming from the under side

frames.name: p134-text-0677
frames.text: Note.—It must be remembered in replacing the chain that the
frames.pdf_text: NOTE.—It must be remembered in replacing the chain that the

frames.name: p134-text-0678
frames.text: oil holes must be on top and the cotter pins on the outside. If

frames.name: p134-text-0679
frames.text: this is not done the cotter pins will catch on the gusset plate of the

frames.name: p134-text-0680
frames.text: epicyclic which have been cut away for the chain links, but which

frames.name: p134-text-0681
frames.text: will not allow the cotter pins to pass by freely.

frames.name: p134-text-0683
frames.text: The track driving chain is surrounded by a sheet steel casing,

frames.name: p134-text-0684
frames.text: 6⅝ inches wide and extending around the chain for its entire length.

frames.name: p134-text-0685
frames.text: This case is supported from the outside and inside plating of the

frames.name: p134-text-0686
frames.text: track extensions of the hull. It is bolted in place by means of

frames.name: p134-text-0687
frames.text: angle irons, and is so shaped as to follow the contour of the chain

frames.name: p134-text-0688
frames.text: and to clear the web on the track sprocket. It is housed within the

frames.name: p134-text-0691
frames.text: The chain casing is in two parts, the outer end being a removable

frames.name: p134-text-0692
frames.text: cap fitting over the sprocket of the roller pinion. In removing the

frames.name: p134-text-0693
frames.text: chain casing the following operations should be followed:

frames.name: p134-text-0694
frames.text: 1. Remove track over the roller pinion.

frames.name: p134-text-0695
frames.text: 2. Remove the bolts from the angle-iron cleats on both sides of

frames.name: p134-text-0698
frames.text: In removing the main casing, it is necessary to remove the track

frames.name: p134-text-0699
frames.text: driving wheel, roller pinion, driving chain, and epicyclic gear. After

frames.name: p134-text-0700
frames.text: these are taken out, the nuts fastening the chain casing to the back-

frames.name: p134-text-0701
frames.text: plates of the hull and the supporting bracket must be removed.

frames.name: p134-text-0702
frames.text: The casing can then be taken out.

frames.name: p134-text-0703
frames.text: Note.—In reassembling, the chain casing must be fixed in position
frames.pdf_text: NOTE.—In reassembling, the chain casing must be fixed in position

frames.name: p134-text-0704
frames.text: before the epicyclic gear is mounted.

frames.name: p135-text-0707
frames.text: To remove the roller pinion, the following operations should be

frames.name: p135-text-0709
frames.text: 1. Break the track and remove the drive wheel.

frames.name: p135-text-0710
frames.text: 2. Unbolt the chain casing and disconnect and remove the drive

frames.name: p135-text-0712
frames.text: 3. Remove the nuts holding the shaft bearing (outer end).

frames.name: p135-text-0713
frames.text: 4. Insert screws in the tap holes in the shaft bearing at the outer

frames.name: p135-text-0714
frames.text: end and screw them, forcing the shaft bearing out.

frames.name: p135-text-0715
frames.text: 5. After the shaft bearing has been removed, the shaft can be

frames.name: p135-text-0716
frames.text: drawn out and the roller pinion removed. This also permits the

frames.name: p135-text-0717
frames.text: floating bushing to be taken out.

frames.name: p136-text-0720
frames.text: The road track passes in the form of a continuous belt, running

frames.name: p136-text-0721
frames.text: around the entire exterior of the hull. There are two of these tracks,

frames.name: p136-text-0722
frames.text: one on each side of the machine. The tracks are propelled by means

frames.name: p136-text-0723
frames.text: of a road-track driving wheel which carrying the sprocket engages

frames.name: p136-text-0724
frames.text: with the pins on the track links. As the track is driven around the

frames.name: p136-text-0725
frames.text: hull, it carries with it the track links which lay down before the

frames.name: p136-text-0726
frames.text: machine a railbed, over which the machine rolls, by means of the road-

frames.name: p136-text-0728
frames.text: These road-track rollers run on the rail faces of the track links,

frames.name: p136-text-0729
frames.text: giving a continuous rail surface, regardless of road conditions. Thus

frames.name: p136-text-0730
frames.text: the road-track driving wheel through its mesh with the road-track

frames.name: p136-text-0731
frames.text: chain, not only propels the machine but also supplies the continuous

frames.name: p136-text-0733
frames.text: The road-track driving wheel is at the rear of the machine. At the

frames.name: p136-text-0734
frames.text: forward end of the machine there is an idler wheel, which serves as a

frames.name: p136-text-0735
frames.text: guide for the track, and at the same time provides a means of adjust-

frames.name: p136-text-0736
frames.text: ment. The position of the idler wheel fore and aft determines the cen-

frames.name: p136-text-0737
frames.text: ter to center distance between the idler and adjusting wheel, and the

frames.name: p136-text-0738
frames.text: sprocket, and hence governs the tension on the track. Moving the

frames.name: p136-text-0739
frames.text: road track adjusting wheel forward tightens the chain, and moving

frames.name: p136-text-0740
frames.text: it toward the rear loosens the chain.

frames.name: p136-text-0741
frames.text: There are 58 rollers which carry the weight of the machine. These

frames.name: p136-text-0742
frames.text: are known as lower rollers, as distinguished from the top road track

frames.name: p136-text-0743
frames.text: rollers, of which there are two. Of the 58 rollers, 28 are fitted with

frames.name: p136-text-0744
frames.text: spring plates which act as spacers, and 30 are plain without the spring

frames.name: p136-text-0745
frames.text: plates. Since the road track is double, these spacers keep the rollers

frames.name: p136-text-0746
frames.text: which roll upon the track at the proper distance apart. The two

frames.name: p136-text-0747
frames.text: top road-track rollers are alike, one on each side at the point where

frames.name: p136-text-0748
frames.text: the track makes its sharpest angle and where, consequently, the

frames.name: p136-text-0749
frames.text: greatest strains may be expected. Elsewhere along the top the track

frames.name: p136-text-0750
frames.text: slides on the top track rails.

frames.name: p136-text-0775
frames.text: Diameter of road track driving wheel

frames.name: p137-text-0780
frames.text: The track links are drop forged steel, having a length from pin

frames.name: p137-text-0781
frames.text: center to pin center of 11.154 inches. The assembly of these links

frames.name: p137-text-0782
frames.text: must be very accurate, and the allowable limit in assembly is 0.004

frames.name: p137-text-0783
frames.text: inches between pin centers; i. e., when links are assembled in pairs

frames.name: p137-text-0784
frames.text: they must agree to within 0.004 inches between pin centers. The

frames.name: p137-text-0785
frames.text: links perform the double duty of binding the chain together, and also

frames.name: p137-text-0786
frames.text: of forming a rail surface upon which the machine rolls. It takes a

frames.name: p137-text-0787
frames.text: left and right link bar to make up one link assembly. These bars are

frames.name: p137-text-0788
frames.text: connected by the pins which are driven through. The pins are sur-

frames.name: p137-text-0789
frames.text: rounded by carbon-steel bushings, which take the wearing stresses,

frames.name: p137-text-0790
frames.text: due to meshing with the road-track driving wheel. Riveted to the

frames.name: p137-text-0791
frames.text: links are the track shoes, which are in contact with the ground. The

frames.name: p137-text-0792
frames.text: track shoes are presssed from armor plate, and so shaped that they

frames.name: p137-text-0793
frames.text: link one over the other. The shape of the track shoe, and the method,

frames.name: p137-text-0794
frames.text: of overlapping is clearly shown above. The track shoe is 26½ inches

frames.name: p137-text-0795
frames.text: in width. Under normal conditions there is a total area of 41.052

frames.name: p137-text-0796
frames.text: square feet of track surface in contact with the ground.

frames.name: p137-text-0798
frames.text: The road-track driving wheel has been described in Chapter VI, see

frames.name: p138-text-0824
frames.text: The road-track adjusting wheel is an idler wheel, having no teeth and

frames.name: p138-text-0825
frames.text: running idly with the track. Its sole function is to act as a guide for

frames.name: p138-text-0826
frames.text: the front end of the track, and also act as a track adjustment, by

frames.name: p138-text-0827
frames.text: means of the belt which allows it to be moved lengthwise, thus in-

frames.name: p138-text-0828
frames.text: creasing or decreasing its distance from the road-track driving wheel.

frames.name: p138-text-0829
frames.text: The road-track adjusting wheel has a diameter of 40.187 inches. It

frames.name: p138-text-0830
frames.text: is of diaphragm construction, the units composing it being a solid rim

frames.name: p138-text-0831
frames.text: which runs upon the track surface of the links. The disc connects

frames.name: p138-text-0832
frames.text: the diaphragm with the rim and with the boss which acts as a hub.

frames.name: p138-text-0833
frames.text: These combined units make up the road-track adjusting wheel proper

frames.name: p138-text-0834
frames.text: and in addition there is the adjustment feature, consisting of an ad-

frames.name: p138-text-0835
frames.text: justing screw which moves the entire action of the adjusting wheel

frames.name: p138-text-0836
frames.text: forward or backward as desired. In order to preserve the alignment

frames.name: p138-text-0837
frames.text: of the wheel there is one of these adjusting screws on each side of

frames.name: p138-text-0838
frames.text: each adjusting wheel. The tension adjusting screw is nickel steel,

frames.name: p138-text-0839
frames.text: 15⅜ inches long, 1⅞ inches in diameter. It is located within a

frames.name: p138-text-0840
frames.text: bracket of cast steel, and there is a guard in the hull plate for the

frames.name: p138-text-0841
frames.text: track-adjusting screw. This guard or opening is 6¾ inches long and

frames.name: p138-text-0844
frames.text: TOP TRACK RAIL UPON WHICH TRACK SLIDES. TRACK SHOWN BROKEN

frames.name: p139-text-0847
frames.text: The track-adjusting shaft is surrounded by a bronze bushing upon

frames.name: p139-text-0848
frames.text: which the track-adjusting wheel rotates. This bushing is inter-

frames.name: p139-text-0849
frames.text: changeable with the bronze bushing on the track driving wheel and

frames.name: p139-text-0850
frames.text: on the roller sprocket. The track-adjusting shaft is drilled for oil

frames.name: p139-text-0851
frames.text: passages, the holes being sealed by pipe plugs, which are removed for

frames.name: p139-text-0852
frames.text: the purpose of injecting oil. These plugs are ⅜-inch pipe plugs.

frames.name: p139-text-0853
frames.text: The nuts of the track-adjusting shafts are hexagonal, 4⅞ inches in

frames.name: p139-text-0854
frames.text: diameter and 4.18 inches across flats. Inserted in the shaft on the

frames.name: p140-text-0908
frames.text: side is a hard copper plug for locking the track-adjusting screw. As

frames.name: p140-text-0909
frames.text: the adjusting screw is turned it moves its entire shaft lengthwise, as

frames.name: p140-text-0912
frames.text: There are three types of road-track rollers. Two of these are lower

frames.name: p140-text-0913
frames.text: road-track rollers and the other is the top or upper rollers. The two

frames.name: p140-text-0958
frames.text: Guard in hull plate for adjusting

frames.name: p140-text-0997
frames.text: Tap plug in roller pin for oil.

frames.name: p141-text-0002
frames.text: types of lower road-track rollers are similar with the exception that

frames.name: p141-text-0003
frames.text: one has spring plates and the other has not. The three types of rollers

frames.name: p141-text-0004
frames.text: are shown on pages 140 and 143. The purpose of the lower road-

frames.name: p141-text-0005
frames.text: track roller is to carry the weight of the machine and provide the

frames.name: p141-text-0006
frames.text: wearing surface which bears upon the tracks, held down by the road-

frames.name: p141-text-0007
frames.text: track links. The machine rolls on this surface upon the steel roller

frames.name: p141-text-0009
frames.text: LOWER ROAD-TRACK ROLLERS WITH SPRING PLATES

frames.name: p141-text-0010
frames.text: The road-track rollers are mounted between the outer and inner

frames.name: p141-text-0011
frames.text: shell plating of the hull and are carried on shafts which are secured in

frames.name: p141-text-0012
frames.text: position by means of angle brackets and U bolts which suspend the

frames.name: p141-text-0013
frames.text: shafts and hold them in position. The shafts are shaped to fit the

frames.name: p141-text-0014
frames.text: toe of the angle bracket, thus locking them securely against turning,

frames.name: p141-text-0015
frames.text: as well as providing a clearance for the tracks. (Page 143.) The

frames.name: p141-text-0016
frames.text: distance between the inner and outer shell plating along the line of

frames.name: p141-text-0017
frames.text: the lower road-track roller is 22¼ inches. The rollers themselves

frames.name: p141-text-0018
frames.text: roll upon the two double tracks provided by the double set of links in

frames.name: p141-text-0020
frames.text: The rollers are 8¾ inches in diameter and are 4⅞ inches wide.

frames.name: p141-text-0021
frames.text: Holding these rollers in their proper relationship on the shaft, on 28 of

frames.name: p141-text-0022
frames.text: the lower road-track rollers there are spring plates. Between these

frames.name: p141-text-0023
frames.text: plates are the road-track-roller springs, 1 inch in diameter, having

frames.name: p141-text-0024
frames.text: three coils 6.652 inches long under a load of 2,500 pounds. The

frames.name: p141-text-0025
frames.text: spring has an outside diameter of 3.937 inches.

frames.name: p141-text-0026
frames.text: The road-track-roller pin which acts as a shaft for the rollers extends

frames.name: p141-text-0027
frames.text: entirely across the housing formed by the inner and outer shell plates

frames.name: p141-text-0028
frames.text: and is 25¾ inches in length and 2.247 inches in diameter. At its

frames.name: p141-text-0029
frames.text: inner and outer ends it carries a bronze bushing, known as the road-

frames.name: p141-text-0030
frames.text: track-roller tube bushing, upon which the road-track-roller tube

frames.name: p141-text-0031
frames.text: together with the two road-track rollers, rotate.

frames.name: p141-text-0032
frames.text: The road-track-roller pin is drilled partially at each end, providing

frames.name: p141-text-0033
frames.text: an oil passage, and is also drilled radially to provide an oil passage to

frames.name: p141-text-0034
frames.text: the bushing. The road-track-roller tube or sleeve is 21½ inches long,

frames.name: p141-text-0035
frames.text: 3.812 inches outside diameter, and 2.75 inches inside diameter. It

frames.name: p141-text-0036
frames.text: carries the rollers, the spring plates, and the spring, all of which

frames.name: p141-text-0037
frames.text: revolve as a unit, together with the tube. The rollers are locked to

frames.name: p141-text-0038
frames.text: the tube by means of a spring-steel split ring of carbon steel, 0.187

frames.name: p141-text-0039
frames.text: inch thick, 0.375 inch wide, and 3.531 inches in diameter.

frames.name: p141-text-0040
frames.text: LOWER ROAD-TRACK ROLLERS WITHOUT SPRING PLATES

frames.name: p141-text-0041
frames.text: The lower road-track-rollers without spring plates are 30 in number

frames.name: p141-text-0042
frames.text: and are similar to the lower road-track rollers with spring plates in

frames.name: p141-text-0043
frames.text: all respects except that the plates and spring are omitted. These

frames.name: p141-text-0044
frames.text: rollers are placed alternately with the spring rollers.

frames.name: p142-text-0047
frames.text: There are two top road-track rollers, located one on each side of the

frames.name: p142-text-0048
frames.text: machine at the top, at the point where the track has an angle, due to

frames.name: p142-text-0049
frames.text: the contour of the machine. These road-track rollers are similar in

frames.name: p142-text-0050
frames.text: most respects to the lower road track rollers, without spring plates.

frames.name: p142-text-0051
frames.text: The rollers are cast iron, 8¾ inches in diameter, operating on the

frames.name: p142-text-0052
frames.text: tube or cylinder in the same way as the lower road-track rollers, the

frames.name: p142-text-0053
frames.text: sleeve being interchangeable. The top road-track-roller pin is also

frames.name: p142-text-0054
frames.text: interchangeable with the lower road-track-roller pin, and the assembly

frames.name: p142-text-0055
frames.text: is quite similar throughout, except for the shape of the roller.

frames.name: p142-text-0057
frames.text: To remove the track, slacken the locking screw and the track-ad-

frames.name: p142-text-0058
frames.text: justing screws. These are the small nuts in the center of the nut on

frames.name: p142-text-0059
frames.text: the end of the track-adjusting wheel shaft. Also slacken the nuts

frames.name: p142-text-0060
frames.text: for the shaft of the track-adjusting wheel on each side of the track.

frames.name: p142-text-0061
frames.text: This allows the following operations to be carried out in removing

frames.name: p142-text-0063
frames.text: 1. Unscrew the adjusting screws on each side of the track-adjusting

frames.name: p142-text-0064
frames.text: wheel until there is considerable slack.

frames.name: p142-text-0065
frames.text: 2. Raise the track links over the mud chute until the road-track

frames.name: p142-text-0066
frames.text: link pins are clear of the bulb rail upon which the track slides at the

frames.name: p142-text-0067
frames.text: top of the machine. Pull the two links together as far as possible to

frames.name: p142-text-0068
frames.text: reduce the pressure on the link pins.

frames.name: p142-text-0069
frames.text: 3. Remove the road-track-link cotter pins and drive out the link

frames.name: p142-text-0071
frames.text: 4. Remove the track from the top by pinching the bars or lifting

frames.name: p142-text-0072
frames.text: the ends by means of a crane.

frames.name: p142-text-0073
frames.text: The machine is then jacked up and the track removed from

frames.name: p142-text-0076
frames.text: If it is necessary to remove a link in any part of the track, the

frames.name: p142-text-0077
frames.text: easiest way is to break the track over the mud pocket, in order to

frames.name: p142-text-0078
frames.text: get plenty of slack where the link is to be taken out, rather than to

frames.name: p142-text-0079
frames.text: have the slack obtained merely by releasing the tension of the track-

frames.name: p142-text-0080
frames.text: adjusting screw. This will greatly simplify the removal of the link.

frames.name: p142-text-0082
frames.text: The track adjustment is accomplished by moving the road-track-

frames.name: p142-text-0083
frames.text: adjusting wheel forward to increase the tension on the track, or back-

frames.name: p142-text-0084
frames.text: ward to decrease the tension. In other words, moving the adjusting

frames.name: p142-text-0085
frames.text: wheel forward is increasing the center distance between the road-

frames.name: p142-text-0086
frames.text: track wheels, thereby drawing the track tighter. This is accom-

frames.name: p142-text-0087
frames.text: plished by slackening the locking screw for the track-adjusting screw;

frames.name: p142-text-0088
frames.text: that is, the small screw in the center of the nut on the end of the shaft

frames.name: p143-text-0090
frames.text: of track-adjusting wheel. The adjustment is then made by screwing

frames.name: p143-text-0091
frames.text: up on the tension-adjusting screw until the desired tension is obtained.

frames.name: p143-text-0093
frames.text: After removing the track, slacken the locking screws and remove

frames.name: p143-text-0094
frames.text: the nuts from both ends of the shaft. Unscrew both tension-adjust-

frames.name: p143-text-0095
frames.text: ing screws until clear of the shaft. Remove the outside track-adjust-

frames.name: p143-text-0096
frames.text: ing bracket and drive the shaft through the opening. The adjusting

frames.name: p143-text-0097
frames.text: wheel should be blocked up before drawing the shaft.

frames.name: p143-text-0098
frames.text: TO REMOVE THE ROAD TRACK DRIVING WHEEL

frames.name: p143-text-0099
frames.text: After removing the track, block up the driving wheel. Remove the

frames.name: p143-text-0100
frames.text: locking plates for shaft ends on both sides of the wheel. Unscrew the

frames.name: p143-text-0101
frames.text: track driving wheel nuts. Remove the bolts holding the shaft bearingr

frames.name: p143-text-0103
frames.text: Insert screws in the tap holes in the shaft bearing (outer end) and

frames.name: p143-text-0104
frames.text: screw them in, forcing the shaft bearing out. After removing the outer

frames.name: p143-text-0105
frames.text: shaft bearing the shaft can readily be pushed out from the inner end.

frames.name: p143-text-0106
frames.text: The driving wheel is then removed and the floating bushing taken

frames.name: p143-text-0108
frames.text: TO REMOVE TOP ROAD TRACK ROLLER

frames.name: p143-text-0109
frames.text: After removing the track, remove the nuts from the road track

frames.name: p143-text-0110
frames.text: roller pin staple, or U bolt, removing the staple. Remove the bolts

frames.name: p143-text-0111
frames.text: on the roller support angles and remove the angles themselves, after

frames.name: p144-text-0149
frames.text: which the road track roller pin can be forced out the outer side of

frames.name: p144-text-0150
frames.text: the hull. The road track rollers can then be removed and the float-

frames.name: p144-text-0151
frames.text: ing bushings taken out. The inner end of the rollers can be reached

frames.name: p144-text-0153
frames.text: TO REMOVE LOWER ROAD TRACK ROLLERS

frames.name: p144-text-0154
frames.text: Jack up the machine from the ground by placing jacks so as to put

frames.name: p144-text-0155
frames.text: the weight of the machine on the hull plating. Then remove the

frames.name: p144-text-0156
frames.text: track in accordance with the directions given on page 142. Remove

frames.name: p144-text-0157
frames.text: the nuts on the road track roller pin staple and take off the staple.

frames.name: p144-text-0158
frames.text: Unscrew the plates on the roller support angle and remove them,

frames.name: p144-text-0159
frames.text: after which the lower road track roller pin can be driven out of the

frames.name: p144-text-0160
frames.text: end. The road track roller can then be removed and the floating

frames.name: p144-text-0163
frames.text: Remove the roller from the machine in accordance with directions

frames.name: p144-text-0164
frames.text: given alone. Apply pressure on the road track roller spring plate,

frames.name: p144-text-0165
frames.text: compressing the spring and removing the tension on the road track

frames.name: p144-text-0166
